nonblocking_issues.description: The legacy `./rintel index` command defaults to a working-directory evidence.db; `./rintel serve` and `./rintel mcp` share the platform product datastore. An isolated archive smoke indexed a two-file Git repository with the legacy CLI and correctly found that MCP did not see it until product-Store registration. The fresh REST registration/index/MCP witness passed.
nonblocking_issues.scope_decision: The frozen MCP3 gate concerns serve ↔ MCP identity, not redesigning the legacy index CLI. Do not silently change its datastore semantics here; document the distinction in DOCS-OSS0.
